meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解改动影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或评估合并请求风险
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or assess pull request risks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析代码变更（git diff），结合项目知识图谱，告诉你哪些文件改了、影响哪些组件、风险多高，并生成可视化数据。
howto.when: 当你需要理解代码变更的影响时，比如审查 pull request 或查看未提交的改动。

say.text: 帮我分析这次提交的代码变更影响。
say.note: Claude 会对比当前分支与主分支的差异。

say.text: 看看这个 PR 改了哪些关键组件。
say.note: Claude 会获取 PR 的 diff 并分析影响。

say.text: 分析未提交的改动，告诉我风险。
say.note: Claude 会检查工作区未提交的变更。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes code changes (git diff) against a project knowledge graph, telling you which files changed, affected components, risks, and generates overlay data for visualization.
howto.when_en: When you need to understand the impact of code changes, such as reviewing a pull request or examining uncommitted changes.

say_en.text: Analyze the impact of this commit's changes.
say_en.note: Claude will diff the current branch against main.

say_en.text: Review this PR and tell me which key components are affected.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the PR diff and analyze.

say_en.text: Analyze uncommitted changes and assess risks.
say_en.note: Claude will check workspace uncommitted diffs.
